Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [I ordered Rugs from your trade program…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a08dfbfe6bee6e5be40aa5f)
I ordered Rugs from your trade program and I was counting on it for my conceptual design presentation for a client except the wrong rug was sent. I asked for it to be overnighted so that I would have it for my presentation and they representative could not change the shipping on my order. Happen to be the only item that my client was not sure about because I didn’t have a sample to show her

May 11, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 18, 2026

Hi Heidi,

Thank you for reaching out to us. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by receiving the incorrect rug for your presentation. We are happy to confirm that your replacement order is currently in transit and is scheduled to arrive today.

Please let us know if you have any further questions in the meantime. We appreciate your patience and have a wonderful rest of your week!
